definition: The group of words of the data model itself: slots and their variants, bindings, the cascade, and the sources a figure rests on.
basis: schema/glossary-term.schema.json, the description of `family`, which lists the families in the order the Glossary page shows them: "`model` holds the words of the data model itself: slots, bindings, the cascade and its sources", and "Each value is bound by exactly one `family-<value>` record, whose term heads the group on the page."
